【原视频简介】
It is quite difficult to grow large, single crystals of table sugar (sucrose).

Crystals form easily enough, but they often clump together to form clusters. In this video, I'm going to try and grow a single crystal.

For a detailed written guide on making this work, check out my son's blog post at https://crystalverse.com/sugar-crystals

---

MATERIALS

I bought my materials in Malaysia, but the items below are similar ones available on Amazon — they work just as well if you’d like to try this experiment yourself.

• 600 mL beaker: https://amzn.to/445FbKh
• Digital scale: https://amzn.to/4olYTsy
• Electric burner: https://amzn.to/47MeHi8
• Nylon fishing line (clear, 0.14 mm): https://amzn.to/3LvU9mF
• Precision tweezers: https://amzn.to/47AS0yB
• Plastic petri dish (90 × 15 mm): https://amzn.to/4r05jjS
• Pipettes: https://amzn.to/4awMvCt

These are Amazon affiliate links — I may earn a small commission if you purchase through them, at no extra cost to you.

Thank you for supporting this channel!
